claim_ceiling: TF-IDF citation hybrids at 174k scale achieve jurist preference 0.7345 with language dominance 0.477, beating the simple semantic-map baseline (0.43) by 71%, and pass both adversarial gates. Dense embeddings show complementary promise (citation heritage AUC 0.79-0.85 at 21-24yr scale, cross-lingual Sachverhalt 0.28 at 1K sample) but cannot be primary navigation (true OOS JP ceiling ~0.53) and require corpus lane deliverables for 174k validation.
evidence_summary: Verified: tfidf_174k_formal_suite_baseline.json (8/8 modes PASS adversarial gates, production mode JP=0.7345/LangDom=0.477), dense_complementary_acceptance_criteria.json (4 criteria frozen with thresholds, evidence at max available scale), citation_heritage_174k_tfidf_latest.json (TF-IDF citation AUC 0.70-0.73 at 174k), bootstrap_ci_dense_metrics_20261006.json (dense citation AUC 0.79±0.03, cross-lingual Sachverhalt 0.28±0.015, Dispositiv 0.15±0.01), v18_coarse_hierarchy_results.json (max branch purity 0.65 < 0.70, NEGATIVE), v17b_label_normalization_174k_latest.json (sample-only, generalization fail), state/evaluation.json (complete, consistent, continue_recommended=false). All 10 negative findings preserved. 3 data blockers explicit. Control plane discrepancy is V28-pattern infrastructure defect, not lane failure.
